title: Nonlinear Concept Erasure: a Density Matching Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the accuracy and Minimum Description Length (MDL) of nonlinear probing classifiers tasked with predicting gender from text representations (GLOVE and Bias in Bios datasets), and evaluating fairness in downstream occupation classification using True Positive Rate Gap (TPR-Gap) and Demographic Parity (DP).

Measuring the accuracy and Minimum Description Length (MDL) of nonlinear probes attempting to predict race-associated linguistic styles (African-American English vs. Standard American English in the DIAL dataset) from text embeddings, and evaluating fairness in downstream sentiment classification using TPR-Gap and Demographic Parity (DP).
